Two defects in the 2026-09-07 correction script, both found by checking it against research_core.ledger rather than by re-reading it. (1) Dividends paid after the position closed fell through every branch and were dropped, 2-10 events per book, up to TWD 160570; surfaced because replay_ledger rejects those streams with 'DIVIDEND requires a current holding'. (2) The non-hit filter removed hits and then took contiguous windows of the remainder, splicing across a hit; consecutive_non_hit_effects treats a hit as breaking the window. Both fixed. Neither changes any published figure: all fifteen books keep their 20-consecutive-attempt values and all four re-scored cards keep their verdicts. The only changed number is the k5 holdout non-hit cell at the +30 percent threshold, 10.1 to 8.9 percent, which now equals the all-attempts value. The as_published column deliberately retains the original dividend-dropping pairing so it still reproduces what the four cards printed. This remains a synthetic diagnostic, not an account drawdown gate.
